job.job_title: Full Stack Developer (React JS + Python FastAPI)
job.job_description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with strong expertise in React JS and modern frontend development along with hands-on experience in Python FastAPI for backend development. The ideal candidate should have a passion for building scalable web applications, writing clean and maintainable code, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.

Frontend development is the primary focus of this role, with backend development experience required for building and integrating REST APIs.

Work Mode: Work From Office (5 Days)

","requirements":"

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using React JS.

Build reusable UI components using Material UI (MUI) and modern frontend best practices.

Manage application state using Redux Toolkit.

Develop secure and scalable REST APIs using Python FastAPI.

Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and stored procedures.

Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs.

Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement pixel-perfect interfaces.

Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.

Perform code reviews and follow coding standards.

Troubleshoot production issues and optimize application performance.

Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and sprint planning.

Work closely with QA and DevOps teams for smooth deployments.

Required Skills

Frontend - (Strong Expertise), React JS (3+ years), JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 / SCSS, Material UI (MUI), Redux Toolkit, React Router, Axios, Responsive Web Design, REST API Integration

Backend - Python, FastAPI, REST API Development, Authentication (JWT/OAuth), API Documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI)

Database

Experience with one or more of the following: PostgreSQL , Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL

Should have experience in: Database Design, Query Optimization, Joins, Stored Procedures, Indexing

Good to Have

Azure Cloud, Docker, Git, Azure DevOps / GitHub, CI/CD Pipelines, Unit Testing (Jest / Pytest), React Hook Form, Form Validation, Redis (Optional)

",
